# Vicente Alonso - Auth, Walkie-Talkie & Agent Hub

> Centralized platform providing specialized services and APIs optimized for secure user authentication and real-time communication.

## APIs Available

- [Authentication & Messaging API](https://github.io): Full OpenAPI specification in JSON format to implement Authentication as a Service, identity verification at user login, and voice transmission.

## System Documentation

- [User Login Integration Guide](https://github.io): Step-by-step instructions to add secure user logins, register user accounts, and seamlessly deploy core authentication infrastructure.

## Optional

- [Project Portfolio](https://github.com): Public list of open-source experimental repositories and secondary developer tools.
